text.insert: The librarian turns source material and worker reports into cited knowledge about game targets and entities. Initial backfill researches subjects across the prepared sources. Active processing reviews new source captures during Sync and completed worker reports during Run. Both paths propose changes through the same validation and apply layer.
Initial backfill starts with a prioritized target list. Each pass researches one target and its linked mechanical entities, including subjects whose records are still empty.

Initial, manual, and epoch-boundary Sync reconcile the accepted checkout and run the configured source pipeline. PR and Discord captures follow their refresh policies. Wiki intake reads the local mirror on an explicit refresh. Acquisition, import, search indexing, and semantic curation have separate completion state.

After report recomputation, shared knowledge intake reconciles identities and citations with the checkout. Sync processes configured source updates before its accepted boundary. The sequence connects those operations to the queued librarian work.

props.title: Epoch Knowledge Intake and Deferred Curation

text.insert: Importers write source records and queue work. Report reconciliation maintains targets and status; deterministic extraction maintains mechanical entities. Librarians propose facts, evidence, links, and curated game concepts or patterns. Their tools read the store; the apply layer validates and writes accepted proposals. Mechanical re-anchoring can also update unchanged code citations under its own contract.

steps.text: Claim. the next queued task by pathway priority: run_closed first (a target's ledger is waiting), then pr_imported, then archival_ingest, then drift_recheck; FIFO within a pathway; claiming sets started_at.

Bound the batch. Split archival slices over 40 messages or 20 wiki sections, PR tasks over 24 attributed rows, and drift batches over 12 subjects before a model pass. Complete the parent and enqueue children at its queue position.

Assemble. the pathway's context: a <pass> block naming the pathway and head_revision (the checkout head, the only revision a code:// citation may carry), the triggering object (run with its narrative, PR with its discussion and CI rows, source slice with a mechanical mention map, the drift scan's flagged subjects with the flagger's verdicts; on pr_imported and run_closed, renamed_from and the drift report per touched subject) plus the touched subjects. entities first, targets last. each with its record and material (source span, analogs, grouped ledger). The touched subjects are the writable scope; everything else is read-only context.

Propose. librarian-v2 runs the rename and drift audit first, then decides per touched subject: new, confirmed (propose nothing), or nothing; returns one JSON object with exactly five keys. facts, links, entities, merges, follow_ups.

Validate. the rejection gate: the proposal is applied in dry run first; every rejected item and every unknown envelope key comes back with a reason and a fix-it message (apply/index.ts REJECTION_MESSAGES). Rejections trigger exactly one retry turn: the model receives its previous proposal and the rejections in a <retry> block and answers with the full corrected proposal. The artifact records validation_gate as clean (no rejections first time) | retried (retry applied clean) | warned (rejections remained; they are dropped and logged).
Apply. the same validation and write gates as the backfill pass; subjects written are stamped in subject_index_state; the task's done_at is set.

Gate. on pr_imported, run_closed, and drift_recheck the flagger re-runs on the touched subjects after apply: clean completes; drift left releases the task once (drift_attempts=1); drift left again completes with the warning 'drift left unresolved after retry' in the pass artifact. The artifact records drift_gate as skipped | clean | released | warned.

Follow-ups. accepted follow_ups (at most 10 per pass, each a subject outside the writable scope) enqueue one drift_recheck task per subject with payload reason 'follow_up: <why>' and requested_by_task, deduplicated against pending drift_recheck tasks on the same subject; the artifact lists follow_ups_enqueued (follow_ups_projected in dry run).

A failed pass or dry run releases its claim. At a later claim after two persisted task failures, split a multi-item task or abandon it with a warning if it cannot split. More than five consecutive pass failures abort the drain. A stop file halts new claims.

Code citations can stop matching when the checkout changes. Reconciliation preserves subject identity, and mechanical re-anchoring updates citations only when the original code can be matched unchanged. The drift flagger identifies remaining changed or unresolved citations for librarian review.

props.title: Drift gate: head moves, pass re-cites, gate verifies

text.insert: After applying a proposal, the consumer rechecks drift for passes that carry drift inputs. A clean result completes the task. Remaining drift releases it for one bounded retry; a second unresolved result completes with a warning for operator review. Completion therefore does not guarantee that every citation is clean.
